verdict.rationale: Several hands-on reports describe replacing Windows with Fedora Workstation on the same machine: a Lenovo laptop where everything worked out of the box, a laptop switched two years ago, a daily driver moved off Windows, and a Framework laptop with minimal hiccups. One user notes that setup took a lot of searching and trial, and the pack has no first-party documentation of the installer or the replace-existing-OS flow. missing for 10: first-party docs on the installer and on wiping or replacing an existing OS, guidance on backing up and migrating data from the previous OS, evidence of a smooth guided setup (one report cites heavy trial and error).
